assessment: Zinc-fingers and homeoboxes (ZHX) has been highlighted as one critical hypoxia-related factors regulator contributing to triple negative breast cancer in this work, which has enriched the upstream regulatory network of HIF-1α signaling. Moreover, identification of key residuals determining biological function of ZHX2 provides novel approaches for treating TNBC via targeting hypoxia pathway.
